items.title: Joseph "One Eyed Babe" Phillips Interview, 1957-03-25
items.q: Well, they had a fella they called Fernand Alexander, that was the trumpet player.

ctx.x: And who else was in it? If I would, what instrumentation did they have? You know, different instruments?
Well, they had a fella they called Fernand Alexander, that was the trumpet player. And now they both the trombone player and then No-No, La Grande. No-No La Grande.
